name: Fantastic Tongue
body:
Your tongue is very long and good at grappling.

Prerequisite: Mogogol.

Benefit: When using your grasping tongue racial trait, your range improves by 10 feet, and you gain a +2 bonus on checks made to grapple a foe in this way.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
